dedupe_keys.name: multi sensor time series dataset for leakage detection in stockholm s water distribution network

description: This dataset contains processed flow and pressure time series recorded at several sensing points of a real water distribution network in Stockholm, Sweden, covering both normal operation and leakage scenarios. It was used in the study "Leakage detection in water distribution networks using machine-learning strategies" (Water Supply, IWA Publishing, 2023) by researchers at KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Uppsala University and Universidade Federal do Ceará. It is available as a free download from Zenodo as a single MATLAB file of about 30 MB, under a CC BY 4.0 licence, with citation of the paper requested. Caveats: coverage is one network, the record does not state the period, sampling interval or how leak scenarios were produced, and the data are the processed form from the paper. Simulation uses: training and benchmarking leak and anomaly detection for water network digital twins and resilience studies. Related record: the BattLeDIM leakage detection benchmark (data-battledim-leakage-detection-benchmark).
